calls: NEW DETAIL: Ralph Lauren Purple Label SS27 (Milan, Jun 19): textured silk-blend suits, relaxed tuxedos, band-collar shirts, utility outerwear, open-weave linen, herringbone; neutrals and indigo; 'adventurous travel' and Italian lakes story. Band collar is a bridge to the thobe neck (inference).

DATA: Cucinelli H1 2026 revenue EUR 749.4M, +13.3% cc. Americas +20.6%, Asia +14.1%, Europe +5.3%. FY26 guide raised to +10-11% cc, ~10% in 2027. Q3 not yet out. Top-end demand is American and Asian, not European.

CONFIRMED (low authority): browns, olive, corduroy and wool trousers with a slight taper and room, chore coats and shackets replacing the topcoat, chunky knits as outerwear (Real Men Real Style). Matches Run 11 colour and Run 08 trouser calls.
NO CHANGE: slim vs relaxed split from Run 12 got no new evidence. Hedge stands: relaxed through the leg, clean line, one lean option.
OPEN: RFW lineup (opens today, still unpublished), Cucinelli Q3, Zegna Q3 (Oct 22), follower recount (sixth run without), price re-check.
